name: Cultist: Eldritch Strength boosts Entropic Slam and Hammer of Twilight through native spell mods (#2202)
contract: 680600 is SpellFamilyName 31 with two ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) effects: effect0 MiscValue=0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE) BasePoints=24 -> CalcValue 25%, SpellClassMask [128,0,16384]; effect1 MiscValue=2 (SPELLMOD_THREAT) overridden by AscensionCultist::ApplyContracts (Cultist ADR 0030, owner ruling O-15 Q-cu-34) from DBC BasePoints=14 to BasePoints=99 -> CalcValue 100%, same classmask. Entropic Slam (804152, 572846) carries SpellFamilyFlags[0]=128 (matches dword0 bit7); Hammer of Twilight (806498/806499/806829/806830) carries SpellFamilyFlags[2]=16384 (matches dword2 bit14). Player::ApplySpellMod resolves both ops: op 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE) is multiplicative (totalmul *= 1.25), op 2 (SPELLMOD_THREAT) is additive-percent (totalmul += 1.00, i.e. 2x threat). The spell_modifier metric applies these mods to a fixed base directly, per apps/coa-gameplay-test/README.md.
